description: This file contains utility functions for performing collective operations in distributed computing with PyTorch, including broadcast, all_gather, and RNG synchronization checks.

classes.name: SyncPayload
classes.description: A generic dataclass for encapsulating synchronization payloads, including stage name, success status, payload data, and exceptions.

methods.name: broadcast
methods.description: Broadcasts data or executes a function on rank 0 and broadcasts the result to all ranks, handling exceptions and success status.

methods.name: all_gather
methods.description: Performs an all_gather operation with synchronization guard, collecting data from all ranks and ensuring stage consistency.

methods.name: all_gather_object_enforce_type
methods.description: Performs an all_gather of objects with additional type checking to ensure consistency across ranks.
